policy: Asset authoring method is chosen per Item. HERO assets require independent source files when clean isolation/animation matters.

candidates.purpose: Test whether one high-detail engraving sheet could supply multiple isolated production assets.

generation.prompt_summary: High-detail 19th-century gothic engraving asset sheet with creature, scientist, hand, window, laboratory table, apparatus and props.

findings.reason: Overlapping collage layout prevents reliable alpha-safe extraction of several HERO elements.

candidates.decision: Do not use the sheet as the canonical source for HERO assets. Regenerate/acquire hero elements individually.
